text: NARROW and KEEP BidsStore[F]. The retained algebra has exactly two operations: deterministic recursive file entries with optional size metadata, and UTF-8 reads. It materially removes NIO listing/reading from BidsProjectLoaderF, enables deterministic listing/read failure injection, and supports portable pure project assembly. Two interpreters are tested: shared InMemoryBidsStore on JVM and Scala.js, and JVM BidsPathStore with blocking/Resource/path-containment behavior. Rejected from this seam: directory APIs, writes, S3/HTTP/browser access, caching, retry, streaming, and runtime execution. Verification: final bidsJVM/test passed 69; the shared store implementation previously passed bidsJS/test within 54 total tests; git diff --check passed; shared store code contains no java.nio, Path, Throwable, or unsafeRun.
